optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, Charging Station Firmware

professionalSummary.text: 14 firmware versions released over-the-air to 3,200+ public charging stations (2022-2025) with coordinated rollout waves and release tickets
professionalSummary.witness: Released fourteen firmware versions over the air to the installed fleet of about 3,200 public charging stations between 2022 and 2025, each in rollout waves agreed with the operations centre and each under a release ticket in my name.

professionalSummary.text: Monitored charging session success rates post-release and handled fleet-wide incidents during on-call shifts, including October 2023 connector firmware bug incident
professionalSummary.witness: Watched the charging session success rate on the fleet dashboard after each release wave and held the field on-call for the station faults the operations centre raised; the fleet-wide fault of October 2023, when a connector firmware bug stopped sessions on one station model, was handled on my on-call shift and is recorded in the operations incident log.

professionalSummary.text: Documented test records for hardware-in-the-loop testing and release notes with known limitations for each version
professionalSummary.witness: Tested each firmware version on the hardware-in-the-loop rig before release, with the rig test record attached to the release ticket. Wrote the release notes for each version, listing the known limitations on the older station models and the hand-over conditions for the field technicians.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated release rollout waves with operations centre, documenting responsibility boundaries in release tickets
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated the rollout waves for each release with the operations centre, recording in the release ticket which checks were mine and which belonged to the operations centre's wave sign-off.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Release tickets for last five versions with rig test records, wave plans, and October 2023 incident log
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the release tickets for the last five versions with their rig test records and wave plans, and the operations incident log record for the October 2023 fleet-wide fault.

skills.text: Firmware release management, hardware-in-the-loop testing, incident response, release documentation
skills.witness: All experience and work sample descriptions confirm these skills.

role.roleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, Charging Station Firmware

evidence.text: Released fourteen firmware versions over the air to the installed fleet of about 3,200 public charging stations between 2022 and 2025, each in rollout waves agreed with the operations centre and each under a release ticket in my name.
evidence.notes: Confirms release to fleet and rollout coordination.

evidence.text: Watched the charging session success rate on the fleet dashboard after each release wave and held the field on-call for the station faults the operations centre raised; the fleet-wide fault of October 2023, when a connector firmware bug stopped sessions on one station model, was handled on my on-call shift and is recorded in the operations incident log.
evidence.notes: Confirms monitoring success rates and on-call handling.

evidence.notes: Confirms on-call handling of fleet-wide incident.

evidence.text: Released fourteen firmware versions over the air to the installed fleet of about 3,200 public charging stations between 2022 and 2025, each in rollout waves agreed with the operations centre and each under a release ticket in my name.

Wrote the release notes for each version, listing the known limitations on the older station models and the hand-over conditions for the field technicians.
